neighbours.label: the word 'there' starting a clause (There is/are, that there was, fronted There he stood), even when it means a place; quiet for 'there' after a verb (stayed there)
fire: There is a small bakery on the corner of our street.
There are three reasons I can't come to the meeting tomorrow.
She said that there was nobody left in the building.
There he stood, soaked from the rain, holding a bunch of flowers.
I doubt there will be enough chairs for everyone.
There once lived a fisherman who never caught a single fish.
Is there any milk left in the fridge?
We knew there had been a mistake when the bill arrived.
quiet: A small bakery sits on the corner of our street.
I have three reasons I can't come to the meeting tomorrow.
She said that nobody was left in the building.
He stood there, soaked from the rain, holding a bunch of flowers.
I doubt we will have enough chairs for everyone.
We stayed there for a week before heading home.
Did you leave any milk in the fridge?
We knew a mistake had been made when the bill arrived.

predictions: 8/8 fire above 0.3, near misses near 0; the 'He stood there' / 'stayed there' twins stay quiet
